changedPaths in launch.go quotes a path with strconv.Quote when the result differs from the path wrapped in plain quotes, or when the path contains ', '. strconv.Quote escapes newlines, CR, U+2028/U+2029, quotes, backslashes and other non-printable characters, so none of them can start a line of their own. A plain path is written as it is.
The new test covers a newline-injected heading, a path with ', ', and a path with a double quote. It asserts the exact expected line and that no raw newline-heading line appears.
The README and usage text changes only describe the quoting. Both match the code.
